scripts.dev: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @app/functions build && firebase emulators:exec --ui "pnpm seed && pnpm -r --parallel --filter !@app/tests run dev"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:shared && pnpm -r run typecheck && tsc -p scripts
scripts.build: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @app/functions build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,storage "pnpm seed && pnpm --filter @app/web build"
scripts.deploy:functions: pnpm build:shared && pnpm --filter @app/functions empaquetar && firebase deploy --only functions --config firebase.deploy.json -P prod --force
